units.source_text: [\[7\]](#part1332.html#w7) 当时风习：男女共寝后，次日早晨男的必写信作诗去慰问，女的必写回信或答诗。

en.t: According to the custom of the time, after a man and woman had slept together, the next morning the man was expected to write a letter or compose a poem to ask after her, and the woman was expected to reply with a letter or answering poem.

units.source_text: 第二天晚上男的必须再到女的那里宿夜，才合礼貌。

en.t: On the second night, the man had to go back to the woman and spend the night there again; only then was his conduct considered proper.
